title: G33: rehearse guarded SliQ-shaped imports through release 147
public_pr_body:
Runs the unchanged full public migration chain through 144 (including 138 → 140 → 141 → 144), then complete releases 145 → 146 → 147 from pinned 9d7725e. Creates its own nonce-labelled, pinned-image, network-isolated PostgreSQL container; verifies identity before SQL, accepts no DB URL, synthetic records only. Auth/Storage prerequisites are explicit test-only schema/JWT functions, not running services.

Committed code 84c3920: 8 passed, zero failed/skipped. Five ungated equivalents replace the direct safeupdate skips in CI 41936446385: G33-SU1 unqualified UPDATE/DELETE including nested function; SU2 small dry-run/commit/count/replay; SU3 whole-file bad-row refusal; SU4 multipart stage/validate/commit/undo; SU5 small+large credit/delivery-note import and undo. Original five cases are named in tests/reviews/g33/README.md; original files/gates remain untouched. The two optional timing skips are separate and not claimed replaced.

Real unmodified pg-safeupdate is built from pinned public source/headers and LOADed before authenticated SQL calls; absence fails rather than skips. All original import kinds remain covered. Public #368's synthetic preprocessor handles report-shaped invoices/payments, followed by the identical app mapper/build functions and guarded importer; supplemental canonical credit/delivery sheets and remaining record kinds exercise 147's live triggers. Reconciliation: invoice total 144.06, linked payment 60.00, credit 12.00, balance 72.06; repeat adds no duplicates. Business/counter/hold/key snapshots are checked; import/audit bookkeeping is explicitly outside the zero-business-write claim.

Paused companies refuse import. The separate DLN numbering hold blocks new notes but deliberately permits authorised historical imports; both hold rows/timestamps and Marpet business snapshots remain unchanged. No trigger, release guard, expected value or safeupdate check was weakened.

Original image-unpack disk failure and extension-file-mode setup failure are retained with final SQL hashes, source/commit/environment/time/exits, dependency hashes and identity receipts in the evidence archive. Lint and TypeScript passed. G33: rehearsal done, 8 passed, 5 ungated replacements; complete Auth/Storage/PostgREST/browser and final release approval are not claimed.

Separate codex branch from main 68f89ca, tests/docs only. No #359/candidate edits, merge, production SQL, real data/private source, Ready label, provider call or message to John.
